ig_caption:
Kubernetes HPA not scaling: TARGETS <unknown> 📉

Traffic is spiking. The autoscaler should add pods. It doesn't.

The HPA scales on CPU utilization = usage as a percentage of the CPU REQUEST.
⚠️ this Deployment has no CPU request
→ "50% of nothing" can't be calculated, so the HPA gives up and you stay on 1 pod.
The event says it: missing request for cpu.

The fix:
✅ give every container a CPU request (here 100m)

Same load → over 700% of the request → 5 pods.

Save this before you autoscale 🔖 Follow for more Kubernetes breaks.

#kubernetes #k8s #devops #autoscaling #sre
yt_title: Kubernetes HPA not scaling: target unknown #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster with metrics-server: a CPU-heavy Deployment with no resources.requests.cpu and an HPA at 50% average CPU utilization. Under load: TARGETS <unknown>/50%, 1 replica; event "failed to get cpu utilization: missing request for cpu".
Fix: requests.cpu: 100m → same load reads 737%/50% and scales to 5 replicas (maxReplicas).

Series: Kubernetes in production, what breaks (live). Follow for more.
